messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=latency-slo-p99; 4 alerts from region=us-west. p99 > 1200ms over last 5m. link: https://dashboards.redwood/inference/latency
alex: acked the PD page, I'm taking first responder. looking at apm and kv-cache heatmap.
miguel: seeing KV eviction spike + queue depth on sidecars, per-host p95 also creeping.
sara: customer-facing: support ticker shows 2 customers with timeouts. flagging for product notifications.
alex: quick mitigation: routing policy -> fallback to dedicated-pool-2 for bursty routes; triggering now.
ops-bot: runbook step 2: increase dedicated-pool-2 replicas by 2. command: kubectl scale deploy/dedicated-pool-2 --replicas=6 -n inference
alex: scaled + warming. also enabling short-lived model-variant (quant-8) for high-concurrency paths.
miguel: confirming tail latencies improving on a couple nodes, p99 dropped to ~900ms after routing change.
sara: product: customers notified via status page that we're investigating latency increase, estimated mitigation <30m.
lee: handing off to @miguel in 18m; if p99 still above 800ms escalate to infra-rotation. I will update pagerduty notes.
miguel: taking over; will keep checking autoscaler and KV eviction metrics, watch for hotkeys.
alex: leaving notes: routing rule id=rr-2024-07-01-04, scaled replicas and enabled quant-8 variant, rollback plan ready.
ops-bot: alert suppression applied for noisy duplicate alarms for service latency-slo-p99 for 15m.
sara: any customer impact summary for post-incident? two timeouts, one retry fixed, one raised support ticket with request id=abc-772.
miguel: minimizing impact: cache-warm path running, p99 now ~420ms for majority, still 2 nodes with higher IO — restarting one replica.
lee: ack, will monitor until fully stable. preparing brief for handoff to next oncall.
alex: thanks team — mark this thread for postmortem and add quick eval against recent rollout rules.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by alex at 1701234573; no escalation triggered.
